name: Frenzied Sea Life

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-03: A Foot in the Door

disable: DC 27 Thievery check (trained) to remove the crown from the altar while avoiding being bitten by the swarming sea life, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 27) to disable the crown's enchantment, breaking Timonithaea's control over the sea creatures.
routine: (one action) The sea creatures attack, dealing 1d10+4 bludgeoning,1d10+4 piercing damage to each creature hostile to Timonithaea within the temple (DC 25 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Aquatic Onslaught
items.text:
Trigger The PCs enter the main temple chamber

---
Effect The chamber fills with sea creatures, then rolls initiative.

text: A swarm of aggressive cuttlefish, octopuses, devil rays, and countless other species of sea life bite and bludgeon Timonithaea's enemies.
